title: Update Genz App static logo asset and ensure header logo rendering remains crisp and aligned

requirements.summary: Regenerate the existing static Genz App logo asset at the same path with a new proposed design inspired by the user’s logo.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` is updated to the newly proposed logo design (512×512 PNG).
The logo has good contrast on light backgrounds, clean edges, and looks sharp when rendered small (approximately 40×40 to 80×80 CSS pixels) with rounded corners.
The app header continues to load the logo from `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` without any broken-image icon, layout shifts, or console errors.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing 512×512 PNG at frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png with the newly proposed, original logo design inspired by the user’s logo, ensuring clean edges and strong contrast on light backgrounds.

requirements.summary: Adjust header logo rendering styles to keep the new logo crisp, centered, and responsive across breakpoints without changing navigation/auth behavior or the asset path.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile and desktop, the header brand area (logo + “Genz App” text) remains vertically centered and does not overflow or overlap navigation controls.
The logo remains crisp (no unintended blur) and preserves its aspect ratio (no stretching/squashing).
No changes are made to authentication/navigation behavior while adjusting logo rendering.

file_operations.description: Refine the header brand area styling for the logo + “Genz App” text to ensure consistent vertical centering and non-overflow across breakpoints; keep using /assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png, preserve aspect ratio, and avoid any changes to auth/nav behavior (only presentation/layout tweaks).
